title: Charge polarity determination
description: Essential: Student must correctly identify the ball as positively charged based on the equilibrium position in the given electric field direction.

title: Electric force calculation
description: Essential: Student must compute F = qE = 3.0 × 10⁻³ N with correct units.

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important: Student must resolve forces (tension, gravity, electric) and apply tanθ = F/(mg) or equivalent equilibrium condition.

title: Mass calculation
description: Essential: Student must derive m = qE/(g tanθ) = 4.0 × 10⁻⁴ kg from equilibrium, with correct units.

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important: Student must apply mgl(1 - cosθ) = ½mv² after field removal, canceling mass correctly.

title: Final velocity calculation
description: Essential: Student must compute v = √[2gl(1 - cosθ)] = 2.0 m/s with correct units.

title: Sign error in force direction
description: Pitfall: Penalize if student incorrectly assigns negative sign to charge or reverses electric force direction in equilibrium setup.

title: Trigonometric confusion
description: Pitfall: Penalize if student uses sin/cos incorrectly in force components (e.g., mixing horizontal/vertical components).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Award if student explicitly verifies unit consistency in calculations (N, kg, m/s).
